id.lead: Rencana NusaFin menghubungkan petani Indonesia, buyer Eropa dan AS, serta konsolidasi pengiriman. Alur dan kebijakan berikut merupakan rancangan layanan, bukan bukti operasi aktif.
steps: Permintaan & konsultasi
Buyer menyampaikan spesies, jumlah, dan negara tujuan. Ketersediaan serta biaya perlu dikonfirmasi.
Pilihan & konfirmasi
Penawaran mencakup ikan, dokumen, dan pengiriman. Buyer membayar di muka setelah menyepakati transaksi.
Konsolidasi & inspeksi
Rencana titik kumpul sendiri: periksa kondisi, simpan foto/video, dan catat kode lot per petani.
Pengiriman ke tujuan
Rencanakan konsolidasi mingguan bersama mitra logistik. Persyaratan spesies dan negara tujuan diperiksa sebelum pengiriman.
Klaim DOA 24 jam
Klaim sejak ikan masuk gudang buyer, dengan foto/video dan kode lot. ≤5% dipotong otomatis; >5% ditangani manual.
Pembayaran petani
100% dibayarkan setelah tiba di gudang tujuan dan klaim ditutup, dikurangi kompensasi DOA. Tenggat pelepasan +7 hari setelah klaim tutup, dapat dikonfigurasi.

Pembayaran setelah tujuan dan klaim tutup
trust: Foto/video saat tiba di titik kumpul menjadi bagian bukti kondisi per lot.

faq: Apa arti batas DOA 5%?
DOA ≤5% dipotong otomatis dari pembayaran petani; >5% tidak otomatis, perlu penyelesaian manual dengan buyer, petani, dan admin.
Kapan petani dibayar?
100% setelah ikan masuk gudang buyer dan klaim ditutup, dikurangi kompensasi DOA. Tenggat +7 hari setelah klaim tutup dapat dikonfigurasi.
Bagaimana jika lewat 24 jam?
Klaim baru ditolak setelah 24 jam. Pembayaran dilepas saat jendela berakhir. Kejadian luar biasa perlu tinjauan manual, alasan, dan audit log untuk override.
Apakah layanan sudah aktif?
Belum. Ini prototipe UI untuk review. Verifikasi, pembayaran, klaim, dan pengiriman belum terhubung ke backend.
Berapa biaya membership?
Petani gratis 1 tahun sejak pendaftaran masing-masing. Tarif buyer dan pengiriman belum final; perlu ditampilkan sebelum transaksi.

en.lead: NusaFin plans to connect Indonesian farmers, EU and US buyers, and consolidated shipping. These workflows and policies describe planned services, not evidence of active operations.
steps: Inquiry & consultation
Buyers specify species, quantities, and destination. Availability and costs require confirmation.
Selection & confirmation
Quotes cover fish, documents, and shipping. Buyers pay upfront after agreeing transaction terms.
Consolidation & inspection
Planned own collection point: inspect condition, retain photos/videos, and record farmer-specific lot codes.
Delivery to destination
Plan weekly consolidation with logistics partners. Species and destination requirements are checked before shipping.
24-hour DOA claims
Claims start when fish enter the buyer warehouse, with photos/videos and lot codes. ≤5% is deducted automatically; >5% is handled manually.
Farmer payment
100% paid after arrival at the destination warehouse and claim closure, less DOA compensation. Release deadline is +7 days after claim closure, configurable.
en.aboutText: Marketplace and consolidation are designed to clarify buyer access, fish inspection, documents, and transaction responsibilities. No guarantee of export outcomes or fish survival.
features: Farmer-specific lot codes for claim traceability
Payment after destination and claim closure
trust: Photos/videos at collection-point arrival form part of each lot’s condition evidence.
Packing, schedules, and cargo requirements must be agreed with logistics partners.
Check health certificates and CITES where applicable, plus US import obligations such as the Lacey Act.
Admin overrides require reasons and audit logs. Backend implementation is not available yet.
en.collectionNote: User-owned Siripku images are illustrations. Not verified stock, grades, pricing, or availability.
doa: Within 24 hours of fish entering the buyer warehouse, with photo/video evidence and lot codes.
DOA compensation is deducted from farmer payments for affected lots.
No automatic deduction. Buyer, farmer, and admin resolve the claim manually.
en.exception: After 24 hours, new claims are rejected and payment is released. Exceptional events may be reviewed manually; overrides require reasons and audit logs.
regions: Import requirements reviewed by country and species. Not a list of active routes.
Import requirements and Lacey Act reviewed before transactions. Not a claim of permits already obtained.

reviews: Example discussion topics: lot codes, destination documents, and quote transparency. Not a customer experience.
Example review topics: clear claim evidence and the 24-hour window. Not an actual shipment outcome.
Example review topics: payment after destination and claim closure. Not proof of payment.
faq: What does the 5% DOA limit mean?
DOA ≤5% is deducted automatically from farmer payments; >5% is not automatic and needs manual resolution with buyer, farmer, and admin.
When are farmers paid?
100% after fish enter the buyer warehouse and claims close, less DOA compensation. The +7-day deadline after claim closure is configurable.
What happens after 24 hours?
New claims are rejected after 24 hours. Payment is released when the window expires. Exceptional events need manual review, reasons, and audit logs for overrides.
Is the service live?
No. This is a UI prototype for review. Verification, payments, claims, and shipping are not connected to a backend.
What does membership cost?
Farmers receive 1 free year from their individual signup date. Buyer and shipping rates are not final and must be shown before transactions.
articles: FCA for air cargo; FOB where suitable for shipping mode. Risk allocation must be clear before transactions.
Condition documentation at consolidation and destination warehouses supports claim traceability.
Requirements depend on species and destination country. Verification required before shipping.
